openings.claim: Unmeasured coupling: A is a strip guide bolted through existing slots, contacting unmarked regions; B is detachable wire with a removable loop around the unmarked end. Routing B through a low eye drilled in A could redirect tension toward guide contacts and keep the plate seated. Bypass retains every guide part, tether, endpoints and separation limit.
openings.discriminator: Unretained drift: supplied 6 mm/five strokes; twenty-stroke drift unknown. A alone may permit lift/escape; B alone may permit drift despite limiting separation. Intact predicts less lift/drift than bypass at matched initial tension. Additive guide-plus-tether rival predicts no routing-specific improvement. Equal passing or merely increased tension leaves coupling unsupported. Routing-specific seating change supports interface effect; without isolated-parent trials, superadditivity remains unestablished.
openings.probe: Check clearance and detachable-loop access without edge contact. Only intact/bypass: baseline/A-alone/B-alone explicitly untested because configuration cap forbids additional fabrication trials. Each: three twenty-stroke runs ending with weaker-magnet spare; three gloved timed removal/return checks. Measure displacement against starting marks, scale tether pull, seating/lift and time. Match contacts, length, initial tension and strokes; bypass only interface. Record setup minutes, loop retensioning and guide adjustments. Use supplied materials/tools within eighty fabrication/twenty observation minutes.
openings.uncertainty: Indispensable slot/low-eye clearance unprovided. Removable glove-operable wire loop must avoid slipping, damage and working-edge contact; capacity unknown. Defeat: unmatched bypass tension, insufficient wire capacity, distorted guide contact, drift >1 mm or removal/return >sixty seconds. Abandon if layout requires drilling/cutting/heating/gluing plate/carriage, obstructing exposed marked 30 mm edge, any added part entering marked stroke clearance, or detaching carriage from rails.

lineage.reason: Preserves relation, rival, comparisons, defeat conditions, uncertainty, resource/stopping caveats and declared uncertain fit.

decision: Clearance-first hypothesis only; geometry, wire capacity and glove operation remain unknown. No deployment or reliable-retention claim; unknown resources cannot relax constraints.
